state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`, Stages 9 and 10 are done, and Stage 11 is in progress.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv loop --owed` and `bun nv loop --settle` exist (`tools/nv/cmd/loop.ts`, `owed` and `settle`; the filter is `owedChecks` in `tools/nv/driver/accept.ts`). A carried check is a stage whose label says `floor`; stage 0 is not carried, as in the old `is_carried`. `tools/git-hooks/pre-push` calls them, so a push is judged again instead of refused outright. `--owed` names hundreds of checks on a tree with uncommitted `tools/nv/` edits, because most carried keys read that tree.

`bun nv audit ci` still exits 1 and is the red Stage 11 check, an open item and not a regression. It names 10 workflow steps that run `python tools/lints.py` or `python tools/release.py`, and the two website sync scripts. No git hook calls Python any more.

`tools/playbook.py`'s module doc still lists the `reviewed` kind. That file goes in Stage 12.

next.title: the last Python steps in CI

items.text: **Port `lints` to `bun nv lints`** -- `tools/lints.py:1` is 250 lines. Then `.github/workflows/ci.yml:409` runs `bun nv lints --check`, and that job drops `setup-python` if nothing else in it needs Python. Add a unit test in `tools/nv/test/`.

**Port `release` to `bun nv release`** -- `tools/release.py:1` is 685 lines: `--check`, `--notes`, `--apply`, `--package`, `--docker-tags`. Then `.github/workflows/ci.yml:594`, every `release.py` step in `.github/workflows/release.yml:140` and `.github/workflows/release-promote.yml:98` run it, and their `setup-python` steps go. This one may need a session to itself.

**Delete the website sync scripts** -- `website/scripts/sync-rules.mjs:1` and `website/scripts/sync-core.mjs:1`. Their data comes from `bun nv render --website`. `website/package.json:1` and `website/config/rule-sections.mjs:1` still name them. Stage 11's bullets at `docs/agent/goals/tooling-overhaul.md:645` are the list.

backlog: `bun nv loop-stats --guard` -- Stage 11's second check, not reached yet (`docs/agent/goals/tooling-overhaul.md:634`).
The website's `tmLanguage` is rendered from the editor's grammar (`docs/agent/goals/tooling-overhaul.md:648`).

Stage 10's "ported to `bun nv`" list at `docs/agent/goals/tooling-overhaul.md:629` still has unported tools: `lints`, `release`, `loop-stats`, `machine`, `observe`, `proctree`, `relink` and others. Stage 12's `audit python` fails until they are ported.
`tools/playbook.py`'s module doc lists the `reviewed` kind; it is deleted in Stage 12.
`data/goals/tooling-overhaul.handoff.json` held its em dashes double-encoded (UTF-8 read as cp1252) before this wrap; worth checking whether `session.py --wrap` writes them that way.
